verdict.rationale: Kino AI exposes agent-facing surfaces (an MCP server and cloud agents editing projects), so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence documents an isolated sandbox, test workspace, or dry-run mode that keeps agents away from real projects or footage. Managing video variants and agents running Kino on their own machines are adjacent features, not sandbox isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
